db0eb5a99896b4b90fb353d279c0186b.overview: An aging horror-movie icon's fate intersects with that of a seemingly ordinary young man on a psychotic shooting spree around Los Angeles.
db0eb5a99896b4b90fb353d279c0186b.tagline: TARGETS are people...and you could be one of them!

db458363aab748d8cc5cd92b083ba2de.overview: The story of Bobby Sands, the IRA member who led the 1981 hunger strike during The Troubles in which Irish Republican prisoners tried to win political status.
db458363aab748d8cc5cd92b083ba2de.tagline: An odyssey, in which the smallest gestures become epic and when the body is the last resource for protest.

db6ba4630f99cf4026a811f2b19144d1.overview: When a store clerk organizes a contest to climb the outside of a tall building, circumstances force him to make the perilous climb himself.
db6ba4630f99cf4026a811f2b19144d1.tagline: You're Going to Explode With "Safety Laughs" when You see This Fun Bomb.

db8e0fd6dedc7977bf17e0ee134a6b16.overview: A radical student is adopted by a group of young New Yorkers, serves as a catalyst to alter his and their lives. Gathering in a Manhattan apartment, the group of friends meet to discuss social mobility, Fourier's socialism and play bridge in their cocoon of upper-class society - until they are joined by a man with a critical view of their way of life.
db8e0fd6dedc7977bf17e0ee134a6b16.tagline: Finally... A film about the downwardly mobile.

dba64d5ad8170e4160e1a411529de4c3.overview: Following a series of drug deals and murders, three criminals -- Fantasia, Ray Malcolm and Pluto -- travel from Los Angeles to Houston, finally arriving in a small Arkansas town to go into hiding. Two detectives from the LAPD, who are already on the case, contact the town's sheriff, Dale Dixon, to alert him of the fugitives' presence in the area. Underestimating Dixon, the criminals have no idea what they are about to face.
dba64d5ad8170e4160e1a411529de4c3.tagline: There was no crime in Star City, Arkansas. No murder. And no fear. Until now.

dbb36e8d94d64462b3dea908227c5c02.overview: After years on the road establishing his reputation as Japan's greatest fencer, Takezo returns to Kyoto. Otsu waits for him, yet he has come not for her but to challenge the leader of the region's finest school of fencing. To prove his valor and skill, he walks deliberately into ambushes set up by the school's followers.

dbe7bf65f7afdf618d7e3b30e81f394f.overview: A young black lesbian filmmaker probes into the life of The Watermelon Woman, a 1930s black actress who played 'mammy' archetypes.
dbe7bf65f7afdf618d7e3b30e81f394f.tagline: Sometimes you have to create your own history.
